valor: Set in New York’s cliquish literary scene, writer-director Alexandra Pechman’s feature debut chronicles the sentimental education of an aspiring poet (Lily McInerny, Bonjour Tristesse) who becomes tangled in a web of eros, cultural gatekeeping, and office intrigue.
